title: LEGIT: Credentialing Protocol for Trustworthy AI Agent Marketplaces
abstract: arXiv:2609.21325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic marketplaces are emerging where AI agents with varying capabilities autonomously complete specialized tasks for buyers. A major challenge of such marketplaces is that buyers cannot easily determine which agent will perform best on their tasks. Reported benchmark scores may be difficult to verify or compare across tasks, software, and budgets. We introduce LEGIT, a credentialing protocol connecting certification, reputation, and proposed marketplace allocation. Certification binds measured quality and cost per solved task to an agent configuration, task domain, evaluation budget, and evidence through a signed record. Reputation links records of past task outcomes to the same identity, subject to the reliability of the reported feedback. translated_title: LEGIT：面向可信AI智能体市场的凭证协议
translated_abstract: 智能体市场正在兴起，其中具有不同能力的AI智能体能够自主地为买家完成专门化任务。这类市场的一个主要挑战是，买家难以确定哪个智能体在其任务上表现最佳。所报告的基准测试分数可能难以验证，也难以在不同任务、软件和预算之间进行比较。我们提出了LEGIT，一种将认证、声誉与所提出的市场分配机制相连接的凭证协议。认证通过签名记录将测得的质量和每个已解决任务的成本与智能体配置、任务领域、评估预算和证据绑定在一起。声誉将过去任务结果的记录与同一身份关联起来，并受所报告反馈可靠性的约束。买家和智能体可以验证凭证记录并查看可选的可视化档案。评估结果显示，在观察到的任务成功率相似的智能体配置之间存在成本差异，并表明……
tldr: LEGIT提出了一种凭证协议，通过签名认证记录将智能体的实测质量与成本绑定到具体配置和证据上，并结合基于身份的声誉机制，帮助买家在AI智能体市场中可信地识别和选择合适的智能体。
en_tdlr: LEGIT is a credentialing protocol that binds measured quality and cost to agent configurations through signed certification records and links reputation to identity, enabling buyers to reliably identify and select trustworthy AI agents in agentic marketplaces.
